$description: Every width breakpoint found in production, classified as official, component, drift, third-party or wordpress-admin (EXPORT-STANDARD.md section 6). Built by scripts/breakpoint-inventory/build-inventory.py; never edit by hand. Drift is logged in production-vs-design-differences.md (entries 30, 31, 33) with the official breakpoint to snap to.
method: Live CSS scan (scan.js) of every loaded stylesheet, @media width conditions only, on the homepage, an article and the obituaries page of each review site, at a 1728px-wide window (media rules are read from the CSS, so the window width does not matter). Cross-origin sheets were fetched; the HTL ad bidder sheet was blocked on most sites. em/rem converted at 16px. JavaScript breakpoints (matchMedia, window.innerWidth) are not included.
